evidence.source: Development fast-lane rollout of contracts 179 and 180, run 31589683887 from exact main 9aef144bcaa826fc01629802ed6c0a0a6404c612, applied under ADR 0024 because both migrations are additive and the lane proves that by reading the pending set rather than trusting the dispatcher. The workflow's own record said only 'Development fast-lane rollout'; this is the account that replaces it, taken from an independent read-only postflight rather than from the job's output. CONFIRMED BY NAMING THE ROWS, not by counting them, which is the lesson of 11 August 2026 when a count against a hosted ledger stayed stale for twenty-five minutes after a successful apply: the ledger holds 180 rows and NAMES 20260812010000 and 20260812020000, and it does NOT name 20260812030000 -- contract 181 is unmerged, so the boundary held exactly. GRANTS, measured on the installed definitions: get_my_private_competitions and get_private_competition_workspace are executable by authenticated and by NO anonymous role, and the two internal helpers -- private_cup_launch_readiness and private_container_lifecycle -- are executable by no browser role at all. CONTRACT 180'S DECLARED PROPERTY, read off the installed row rather than the migration text: uses_season_prediction_card is true for main_predictor, original_predictor and predictor_cup, and FALSE for last_man_standing and ko_predictor -- marking Last Man Standing would have handed a season entry to every LMS entrant. THE DEFECT IS DEMONSTRATED FIXED ON REAL HOSTED DATA, which is the claim a pgTAP suite cannot make: for a real user holding a private Predictor Championship membership, the path /leagues actually uses -- public.leagues joined to league_members -- returns ZERO rows, while get_my_private_competitions returns total 1 with a derived lifecycle_state of 'running'. That is PPLAY-001 reproduced and closed at the database on the project it was reported on. Development holds three private containers carrying ten live memberships, and none of the three is reachable through public.leagues. IT SCHEDULES NOTHING: ten cron jobs before and after. Euro publication is still hidden and EURO-001 is unchanged. It launched no competition, drew no Championship, confirmed no provider result and imported no football. Nothing player-owned was written: both migrations add a column with a default, create functions and redefine two, and neither contains an INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE against any player-owned relation -- 24 auth users, unchanged and measured before and after. THE FRONTEND HALF IS NOT CLAIMED: /leagues still calls get_my_game_leagues for bonus-game containers, so the player-visible defect is live in the application even though the authority that fixes it is now hosted.
